_comment: PDK version pin for the sky130-gcedram 2T-min bitcell transient
write/read/hold testbench (issue #27).
family            sky130 PDK family (via volare -- a stock open_pdks
distribution, not a local fork)
variant           sky130 flavor directory to use (A/B differ in metal
stack only; irrelevant to a device-level SPICE sim)
open_pdks_commit  the volare version hash this testbench and its
committed results are pinned against. Deliberately
the SAME pin as sim/leakage/pdk.json and
design/pdk.json -- this study cross-checks its
transient hold decay against the DC leakage numbers
recorded in sim/leakage/results/leakage_results.csv,
so a divergent PDK pin would silently invalidate
that comparison.
install_command   reproduces this exact install
default_pdk_root  fallback PDK_ROOT if $PDK_ROOT is unset
ngspice_lib       the combined ngspice model-library include, relative
to the variant dir -- this is the ONLY PDK file this
testbench references; no local model edits.
design_netlist    the derived bitcell netlist this testbench includes
verbatim (never transcribes). Regenerated from
design/gain_cell_2t.sch by design/regen_netlist.sh.
extracted_c_sn_json  source of the DEFAULT lumped storage-node
capacitance (parasitics.nets[sn] ground capacitance
plus its lateral coupling terms), issue #7.
process_corners   the MOS corner sections this testbench sweeps,
verified against the .lib sections of
libs.tech/combined/sky130.lib.spice for this pinned
commit: tt/ss/ff/sf/fs are the standard MOS corners.
temperature_c     the temperature points this testbench sweeps -- the
same -40/27/125 C grid sim/leakage/pdk.json pins.
